data.name: Eyaad
data.gender_notes: Eyaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings joy and blessings, a gift or present. The name Eyaad carries the meaning “Gift, Present” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Eyaad usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, present and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringing joy and blessings to others
data.etymology: Eyaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Present.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eyaad total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إياد
in_arabic.meaning: إياد يعني التمكين و القوة و الدعم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إياد مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ي-أ-د' الذي يعني التمكين و القوة و الدعم. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية و يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالقوة و الدعم الإلهي. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية ١٢٥ 'وَأَيَّدۢنَاهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلۡقُدُسِ' حيث أيد الله نبيه عيسى بروح القدس.

in_urdu.name: ایاد
in_urdu.meaning: ایاد کا مطلب ہے طاقت، قوت، اور حمایت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایاد نام عربی جڑ 'ی-أ-د' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، قوت، اور حمایت۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں بڑے پیمانے پر استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس کو الہی قوت اور حمایت حاصل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इयाद
in_hindi.meaning: इयाद का अर्थ है शक्ति, बल, और समर्थन
in_hindi.long_meaning: इयाद नाम अरबी मूल 'ي-أ-د' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, बल, और समर्थन। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है और इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जिसे ईश्वरीय शक्ति और समर्थन प्राप्त है।

in_pashto.name: ایاد
in_pashto.meaning: ایاد د قوت، زور، او ملاتړ مطلب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایاد نوم د عربي ريښې 'ي-أ-د' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې د قوت، زور، او ملاتړ. دا نوم په ډیرو اسلامي کلتورونو کې کارول کیږي او د هغه چا معنی لري چې د الهي قوت او ملاتړ څخه برخمن دی.

in_english.name: Eyaad
in_english.meaning: Eyaad means strength, power, and support in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eyaad is derived from the Arabic root 'ي-أ-د' (y-'-d), which signifies strength, power, and support. It is a popular name in Islamic cultures, symbolizing a person who is endowed with divine strength and support. The term is referenced in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Baqarah, Verse 253 and Surah Al-Ma'idah, Verse 120, emphasizing the concept of divine support and empowerment.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Eyaad" carries a beautiful meaning, as it represents the idea of bringing joy and blessings to others through acts of giving and kindness. In many Islamic cultures, gift-giving is a valued tradition, especially during special occasions such as weddings, births, and religious holidays like Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha. By giving a thoughtful and meaningful gift, the giver aims to uplift the spirit and bring happiness to the recipient. The name "Eyaad" embodies this cultural ideal, acting as a reminder of the joy and blessings that come from sharing, generosity, and kindness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Eyaad" can be seen as a reminder of the blessings and gifts that come from Allah. The Arabic root of the word "ya'ud" (which makes up part of "Eyaad") means "to be grateful, thankful, or pleased," highlighting the importance of recognizing and appreciating the blessings bestowed upon us. This spiritual significance is reflected in the concept of worship, as Muslims strive to offer thanks and praise to Allah through their daily actions and deeds. The name "Eyaad" can serve as a reminder of the blessings that we receive, the importance of expressing gratitude and thankfulness, and the joy and spiritual growth that can come from giving to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift, Present" symbolizes One who brings joy and blessings, a gift or present. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Eyaad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift, present.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Eyaad ibn Ghanam al-Kindi (d. 866 CE) The name Eyaad carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Ghanam was a prominent scholar and philosopher in the Islamic Golden Age. He is known for his contributions to various fields including philosophy, mathematics, and astronomy. Eyaad is a variant of his name.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Eyaad remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
